Problem Statement
Write a program to demonstrate single inheritance by creating a Vehicle class and a Car class.
Description
Create a superclass named Vehicle containing:
vehicleName
vehicleNumber
Create a subclass named Car containing:
mileage
Read the values and display:
Vehicle Name
Vehicle Number
Mileage
Estimated Distance for 10 Litres of Fuel

HondaCity
TN59AB1234
18

Distance for 10 Litres: 180
